articles.summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. ("Lumentum") today announced that it will release its fiscal first quarter 2027 financial results on Thursday, November 5 th , 2026, after the market closes. Lumentum will hold an audio webcast the same day at 2:00 p.m. PT/5:00 p.m. ET. A live audio webcast of the call and replay will be available in the Investors section of the Lumentum website at http://investor.lumentum.com . Analysts planning to participate in the interactive QA portion of the webcast are encouraged to pre-register: analyst pre-registration link . articles.summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE), Astera Labs, Inc. (NASDAQ: ALAB), and Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) today announced a joint demonstration of PCIe-over-optics connectivity for AI rack-scale architectures at the 2026 OCP Global Summit in San Jose, California. The rack-level demonstration combines an Astera Labs Scorpio Smart Fabric Switch with Lumentum's 1060 nm VCSEL-based optical interconnect platform and Corning multimode fiber connectivity. The demonstration will be available at Astera Labs booth #B34 from October 12-15. The demonstration will showcase fully operational optical links that use VCSEL transmitters and photodetectors to extend PCIe connectivity within an AI rack. By transporting PCIe over many parallel optical channels, the architecture is designed to help address the reach, cable density, signal integrity, power, and thermal constraints that can limit conventional electrical interconnects as rack-scale AI systems grow.
